what_this_is: The derived floor this round already computed, copied to where the dashboard reads it. Not a receipt and not an invoice: a receipt says the run stood behind a figure, this says someone priced the run's tokens afterwards from outside it. A floor because 56 of 510 calls reported no usage at all. Solving only -- grading is not in it.
method: roll_up_round.py --ledger over the 6 run ledgers of this round's relay (2 lineages, 6 legs), priced with the committed receipt price table (sha256 b01b384c...); the same fingerprint the run's own task records carry. Copied from docs/run_records/round_state.json cost.ledger_cross_check and not re-priced here. Covers every lineage, $14.386586 of it work a later lineage superseded. Excludes grading.
